title: Ubisoft opens Motherbrain, a generative AI studio 🤖
subject: ubisoft
description:
Do you want AI teammates in Ubisoft games? 👇

Ubisoft's latest earnings report confirms Motherbrain, a new subsidiary focused on AI for gameplay innovation and the team behind the generative AI experiment Teammates.

Sources: Ubisoft earnings report via VGC (Nov 19, 2026)

scenes.text: Ubisoft now has a studio built around generative AI.
It's called Motherbrain. Ubisoft's November 19 earnings report lists it as a subsidiary focused on AI for gameplay innovation.
Motherbrain is the team behind Teammates, Ubisoft's experiment with AI squadmates you talk to through voice chat.
CEO Yves Guillemot says it will build proprietary gameplay technology for creators across the company.
The name leaked in September through a trademark. It's still unclear whether Motherbrain's work will ship as its own game or inside other Ubisoft titles.
